tools.name: gymmaster_list_kpi_categories
tools.description: List the KPI category names (for example member_statistics, sales_made, class_summary). Use them with gymmaster_get_kpi_categories. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/report/kpi/categories/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_kpi_fields
tools.description: List the KPI field names (for example current_members, new_memberships, membership_retention). Use them with gymmaster_get_kpi_fields. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/report/kpi/fields/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_get_kpi_categories
tools.description: Get the KPI values for one or more categories over a date range. Set grouped_categories to false for one flat list. GymMaster Report API: POST /api/v2/report/kpi/categories.

tools.name: gymmaster_get_kpi_fields
tools.description: Get individual KPI field values over a date range, for example current members or new memberships. GymMaster Report API: POST /api/v2/report/kpi/fields.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_standard_reports
tools.description: List the standard report ids and names (for example Current Members, All Bookings). Use an id with gymmaster_run_standard_report. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/report/standard_report/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_run_standard_report
tools.description: Run one standard report for a date range, the same data as Report and Till → Standard Report. Member reports can include member names. GymMaster Report API: POST /api/v2/report/standard_report.

tools.name: gymmaster_list_dashboards
tools.description: List the dashboard widget endpoints (type kpi or graph) for gymmaster_get_dashboard. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/dashboard/list.

tools.name: gymmaster_get_dashboard
tools.description: Get the figures for one dashboard widget. Without dates, GymMaster uses the current date. GymMaster Report API: GET /api/v2/dashboard.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gymmaster_get_kpi_categories, gymmaster_get_kpi_fields · Public sink: gymmaster_get_kpi_categories, gymmaster_get_kpi_fields, gymmaster_run_standard_report · Destructive: gymmaster_run_standard_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gymmaster_get_kpi_categories, gymmaster_get_kpi_fields · Public sink: gymmaster_get_kpi_categories, gymmaster_get_kpi_fields, gymmaster_run_standard_report · Destructive: gymmaster_run_standard_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
